subject: 3733 S. Choke Cherry Slope Waiver
comment: Carlos, I'm writing you to voice my conceri'is and to go on record, regarding the requested (Slope Waiver in the FCOZ). I will not be able to attend or watch the meeting via live stream, I will be on an airplane at that time. As I hope you are aware, the rest of the residence on Choke Cherry Dr. had to follow the strict rules of the FCOZ/Urban Interphase, and built within its limits, even though it caused us quite a bit of additional hardship and expense. A couple of the residents, did apply for a variance from a 30' set back to a 20', and were granted. I feel for the Gebler Family. They seem to be really nice people and have probably spent quite a bit of money and time, to build a new home. But I also feel they should've done their due diligence, before purchasing the lot. That way, they would know, if what they wanted to build would be allowed by law. There's a reason why the peat map shows the buildable area of each lot on Choke Cherry. Best, Randy Kerr 3717 S. Choke Cherry 1
